newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Human edges up despite weak Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Human edges up despite weak Q1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Human Rt advanced one percent in early trading on the Budapest Stock Exchange despite a weak January-March earnings report, traders said.
"I expected Human to fall after these earnings," one trader said. "It seems, however, that its recent falling price already reflected expectations of a weaker first quarter."
Human opened at 2,700 forints, below Friday's close of 2,720 and at 1009 GMT traded at 2,750 forints. Human reached its lowest level this year on Friday at 2,600 forints.

Human released its January-March consolidated HAS earnings report on Monday morning which showed a fall in operating profit to 173.5 million forints from 204.0 million, while its after-tax profit edged up to 205.6 million from 199.6 million.
Net sales rose to 4.033 billion forints from 3.368 billion.
